    Positive Figure 13E supplement reduction #

    This file proves the first source-facing part of the positive Figure 13E argument. The quotient by the two square relations cannot create the transit direction prohibited by either outer arrow: a hypothetical transfer of the image of tau lifts with an error in the corresponding relation-ideal corner, and that error is absorbed into a unit multiple of tau.

    ¬AllowsCotransit ((figure13QuotientFunctor S f g P).map f)

    Source-dually, the Figure-13 quotient preserves the prohibited transit direction of the right outer arrow.

    let F := figure13QuotientFunctor S f g P; have Pbar := RoiterFigure13Quotient.quotientMiddlePowerParameter S f g P hXY hYZ hleft; (Pbar.tau ^ 2).asHom ∉ RoiterFigure13E.throughObjectSubmodule (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)

    The middle square in the Figure-13 quotient does not factor through the left outer object. A hypothetical factorization has a dominant cycle through the zero representative alpha; lifting it changes the ambient square only by a tau^3-term. The resulting ambient unit-ray equality contradicts alpha beta = 0 and the nonzero right square arm.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RoiterFigure13EAmbient.false_of_figure13_exact_hard_branch {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {A : Type v} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [Module.Finite k A] {ι : Type x} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : SplitBasicIdempotents) [HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k S.ProjectiveCategory] [Infinite k] {X Y Z : S.ProjectiveCategory} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (P : ClosedZigzagTransfer.OrientedRadicalPowerParameter Y) (R : ZeroRepresentativePair S f g) (hfinite : MildAlg k A) (hfspan : twoSidedEndomorphismSpan k f = ⊤) (hgspan : twoSidedEndomorphismSpan k g = ⊤) (hXY : X ≠ Y) (hYZ : Y ≠ Z) (hfNotC : ¬AllowsCotransit f) (hgNotT : ¬AllowsTransit g) (hleft : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (P.tau ^ 2).asHom ≠ 0) (hright : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (P.tau ^ 2).asHom g ≠ 0) :
    False

    The exact hard branch is impossible for a representation-finite algebra: Figure 13D supplies zero representatives, the four source-printed Figure 13E supplements hold for them, and Figure 13E forbids those supplements.
